T: Last day of camp. First night of snacks.
D: The counsellors at a 1981 summer camp try to sort out their love lives on the last day before everyone goes home.
P: Serve the snacks when the last day at Camp Firewood begins.
S: Gene the camp cook and his talking can of vegetables

Corn, peas, carrot and spring onion in a crisp chickpea flour batter with cumin and chilli, fried golden, with a lime and coriander yoghurt. Mix 150g besan (chickpea flour), 1 tsp cumin, half a tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp salt and about 180ml water into a thick batter. Stir in 150g corn kernels, 100g peas, 1 grated carrot and 3 sliced spring onions. Heat 3cm oil to 180C and fry heaped tablespoons for 3 minutes, turning, until crisp. Drain. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with lime juice and chopped coriander for dipping.
the Camp Firewood campfire on the last night of summer, 1981

Marshmallows toasted golden over the flame, squashed between graham-style biscuits with milk chocolate and a spoon of salted caramel. Make the caramel: melt 100g sugar until amber, whisk in 80ml cream and 20g butter, then half a tsp salt and cool. Lay 16 digestive or wheatmeal biscuits on a board and top 8 with a square of milk chocolate (100g total). Toast 16 large marshmallows on skewers over a fire or gas flame until golden. Push 2 onto each chocolate biscuit, spoon over caramel and squash with a second biscuit.
M: the Camp Firewood mess hall, summer of 1981

Saucy beef mince cooked down with capsicum, onion, tomato and brown sugar, piled into toasted slider buns with cheddar and crunchy pickles. Brown 500g beef mince with 1 diced onion and 1 diced green capsicum for 8 minutes. Add 2 garlic cloves, 200ml tomato sauce, 2 tbsp Worcestershire, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp mustard and 100ml water and simmer 15 minutes until thick. Toast 12 slider buns, add a slice of cheddar to each base, pile on the mince and top with sliced pickles.
W: Last day bug juice ice blocks

Strawberry, watermelon and orange blended into a bright red fruit punch with lime, frozen into ice blocks with chunks of fresh fruit inside. Blend 300g watermelon, 150g strawberries, the juice of 2 oranges, the juice of 1 lime and 2 tbsp honey until smooth. Dice a few extra strawberries and drop them into 8 ice block moulds. Pour in the punch, add sticks and freeze for at least 6 hours. Run the moulds under warm water for a few seconds to release.
K: the classic camp drink on every Camp Firewood table

A big jug of red fruit punch made with fresh orange, pineapple and cranberry juice, raspberry cordial and lemonade, floating with orange and berries. In a large jug, mix 400ml cranberry juice, 300ml pineapple juice, the juice of 2 oranges and 60ml raspberry cordial. Chill 1 hour. Just before serving, add plenty of ice, 600ml cold lemonade, a sliced orange and a handful of frozen berries. Stir once and ladle into plastic cups.
